item.title: Florida man charged with murder in ex-fiancée's 2011 disappearance
item.description: Michelle Parker disappeared the same day that an episode of "The People's Court" aired that featured Parker and the suspect, Dale Smith Jr., in a contentious dispute over an engagement ring.

item.title: Breaking down September's CPI report as inflation rises to 3.7%
item.description: Inflation accelerated to 3.7% in September as energy costs soared amid President Trump's war with Iran, a new CPI report shows. CBS News reporter Emily Pandise has more.

item.title: Kalshi traders betting Democrats will take Senate control
item.description: Traders on Kalshi are starting to think Democrats will take control of the Senate. CBS News executive director of elections and surveys Anthony Salvanto digs into the trends. Kalshi is sponsoring the use of its prediction market data in CBS News election coverage this year.

item.title: Houthis launch new attack on Saudi capital as Trump mulls strikes
item.description: Iran's Houthi allies launch a new attack on Saudi Arabia and promise more to come as Trump considers U.S. action on the new front line in the wider Mideast war.

item.title: Tech workers aligned with North Korea using laptop farms to infiltrate U.S. companies, FBI says
item.description: Federal officials conducted raids at over 40 so-called "laptop farms" across Texas that the Justice Department says are controlled by North Korea as part of a scheme aimed at fraudulently securing remote jobs to help fund its nuclear program. Adam Meyers, CrowdStrike senior vice president, and Brett Leatherman, FBI Cyber Division assistant director, join to discuss.

item.title: Average diesel price likely to break all-time record in October, petroleum analyst says
item.description: Inflation rose in September to 3.7%, according to the latest Consumer Price Index, three weeks before the midterm elections. The increase is largely driven by energy costs. Patrick De Haan, head of petroleum analysis at GasBuddy, joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Houthi attacks complicating Trump administration's efforts ahead of midterms
item.description: Iran-backed Houthi rebels launched new attacks against Saudi Arabia Wednesday, including a ballistic missile that was intercepted over Riyadh, a Saudi military spokesman said. Matt Kroenig, nonresident senior fellow at the Atlantic Council, joins "The Takeout" with analysis.

item.title: Data center builder offers Kansas town residents $10,000
item.description: Digital Realty is offering utility and property tax credits to residents of De Soto, Kansas, in a bid to win public support for a data center facility.

item.title: Pollster Frank Luntz on midterms 20 days from Election Day
item.description: CBS News polling has shown Latino support for Republicans is far below what it was in 2024. Pollster Frank Luntz joins "The Takeout" to discuss the state of the midterms with 20 days until Election Day.

item.title: Iran war and affordability take center stage in Senate debates
item.description: The economic backdrop of the 2026 midterms is causing political heartburn for many Republicans. CBS News congressional correspondent Caitlin Huey-Burns joins "The Takeout" with takeaways from the Maine, Georgia and Iowa Senate debates.

item.title: Ilhan Omar's relatives subpoenaed as part of immigration probe
item.description: The subpoenas were issued on Friday, just days before Omar's home in Washington, D.C., was searched early Monday morning by investigators from ICE's investigative unit.

item.title: AI now linked to 84% of ransomware attacks, report finds
item.description: A new report by cybersecurity firm Semperis found that artificial intelligence is now linked to 84% of ransomware attacks. CBS News homeland security correspondent Nicole Sganga has the details.

item.title: Trump rallying in Arizona with 20 days until midterms
item.description: President Trump returned to the campaign trail on Wednesday, trying to sway Arizona voters with 20 days until the midterm elections. CBS News immigration correspondent Camilo Montoya-Galvez reports.

item.title: Dow closes in the red after report finds inflation rose in September
item.description: Inflation jumped 3.7% in September from a year ago, driven by higher energy costs, according to a government report released Wednesday. CBS News business contributor Javier David joins with analysis.

item.title: On dating apps, men use AI to put their best face forward
item.description: How much AI is too much when it comes to finding love on the apps? "It's very subtle," one dating app user said of his AI-enhanced photos.

item.title: Inflation surged in September as U.S. energy costs jumped
item.description: Gas prices, which jumped 9.1% in September from August, accounted for more than half the monthly rise in inflation.

item.title: U.S. banks dropped customers over political views, regulator says
item.description: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency said nine of the top U.S. banks "debanked" customers over their political or religious views.

item.title: 911 call shows Hayden Panettiere was given CPR on day she died
item.description: Zach Hickerson, the brother of Hayden Panettiere's on-again, off-again boyfriend, Brian Hickerson, called 911 and attempted CPR on the actress before she was declared dead.

item.title: Earth's "vital signs" pushed to record extremes in 2026, report says
item.description: Climate change has pushed the planet's environmental systems "deeper into uncharted territory," researchers said in a new report centered on the state of Earth's climate in 2026.

item.title: Netflix cutting workforce as its revenue growth slows
item.description: The layoffs will affect the company's product, tech, legal and HR teams, Netflix leaders said in a memo to employees.

item.title: Pope's cancer prognosis may depend on these factors, doctors say
item.description: Pope Leo XIV was diagnosed with lung cancer after a surgery that removed a nodular lesion from his right lung, the Vatican said.

item.title: New details in text messages between Jane Doe and frat members
item.description: One of the accused fraternity members, who was later expelled, wrote to her: "I genuinely hope ur not catching as much heat from this as we r."

item.title: These documents tell the story of the Cornell rape allegations
item.description: Hundreds of pages of documents obtained by CBS News detail Jane Doe's allegations, the Cornell police investigation and responses of some of the accused Chi Phi fraternity members.

item.title: Fossil overlooked for 100 years ID'd as new dinosaur species
item.description: A fossil discovered 100 years ago in the U.K. has been identified as a previously unknown cousin of the T. rex, and it "definitely would have chased us."

item.title: German police seize robot that allegedly groped a teenage girl
item.description: German police have seized a humanoid robot after it allegedly touched a 16-year-old girl in an indecent manner and made sexually suggestive gestures.

item.title: Social Security announces cost-of-living increase for 2027
item.description: The 2027 cost-of-living adjustment is the largest since 2023. Here's how it will impact the typical benefit check starting early next year.

item.title: Cruise passenger who went overboard rescued after 20 hours at sea
item.description: The incident occurred when the Royal Caribbean ship Odyssey of the Seas was sailing southwest of the island of Zakynthos, the Greek coast guard said.

item.title: AI linked to 84% of ransomware attacks, new report finds
item.description: Amid escalating threats to businesses, former White House cyber chief warns autonomous attacks are already here.

item.title: OpenAI employee accused of planting recording device in office
item.description: A Saudi national who worked at OpenAI as an engineer is suspected of planting a recording device in one of the company's conference rooms.

item.title: The real story behind Winnie the Pooh, born in the shadow of WWI
item.description: When soldiers of World War I traveled to Europe to fight, they would bring real animals meant to lift their spirits. One of them was an orphaned black bear from Canada. Tina Kraus explains how the cub inspired Winnie the Pooh, now 100 years old.
